login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use your verified email and password to open your workspace.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Create your account, then verify your email. Staff and administrator access is assigned by an administrator.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: Enter your account email to request a password reset link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: Open the password reset link from your email before saving a new password.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Open the Firebase verification link sent to your email. Once verified, return to sign in. To request another link, use your email and password on the sign-in screen.

welcome.title: Welcome to Upcycle
welcome.description: Coordinate campus waste, community activities, and sustainability records from one workspace.

role.title: Choose your access
role.description: Select student, volunteer, or vendor when creating your account. An administrator assigns campus and staff access.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Authenticator setup and verification are unavailable until an MFA provider is configured and enforced by the backend.

success.title: Return to your email
success.description: For password recovery, follow the reset link sent after a successful request. Return to sign in after completing the reset.
